sources.snippet: Overview Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-GGUF is an uncensored variant of Qwen3.8-27B created by huihui-ai using abliteration techniques to remove refusal mechanisms from the base model. This 27 billion parameter model retains the first 15 layers without ablation, leaving multimodal token processing (MTP) and visual capabilities untouched.
